scenes.heading: CLONE A VOICE ON YOUR MACHINE
scenes.say: Want a voice clone without sending your audio to the cloud?

scenes.heading: VoiceStudio
scenes.say: VoiceStudio is a desktop app that clones a voice from a short sample, designs a new one, and dubs video into other languages.

scenes.heading: DUB A VIDEO
scenes.say: Drop in a video, pick a language, and it writes the dubbed version next to the original, with the timing kept in sync.

scenes.heading: SAMPLE TO CLONE
scenes.say: Give it a short clean sample, and the clone speaks new lines in the same voice.

scenes.heading: CHOOSE YOUR MODEL
scenes.say: The models run on your own computer, so check the README for the hardware each one needs before you download.
Would you clone your own voice or dub a video first? Comment VOICE and I'll pin the link.
